prompts.text: # approvals-shell-only: only VPS shell commands need Brett's approval Brett, Nov 5 2026 (voice): "I don't need an approval for you to show me screens. The only thing that needs approval is a VPS or a shell command." (He also confirmed notes and to-dos must not need approval.) ## Change - Default policy for every service tool becomes `allow` (runs at once, no veto countdown, no confirm), EXCEPT: - `vps.run` and `vps.logs` (shell and log reads on the VPS): keep needing approval. - Any other tool that runs a shell command on a machine (search every connector/device for shell/exec/terminal tools)…
